outputs.explanation: Spatial deconvolution plots display per-spot values as a heatmap overlaid on tissue images; each spot already represents an individual measurement, so this is a heatmap-type visualization exempt from requiring additional overlaid individual data points.

Box plots of fraction of cells for each immune population show individual data points (jittered dots for each biological replicate/spot) overlaid on the box plots for both T11b-high LUSC and LUAD groups.
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots; overlaying individual data points on this plot type is not applicable and would not be readable.

Bar graph shows log2 fold change values derived from differential gene expression analysis with associated p-values; each bar represents a single computed statistic (fold change) rather than a mean of directly comparable individual replicate measurements, so individual data points are not applicable here.
Panel E consists of representative H&E and IHC micrograph/photograph images, not a plot of averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
